name: Baker Street, 1895
purpose: The fan-fiction companion use case: characters taken from a public-domain work, on the real clock, with a daily life and messages. What they know of their past is carried by the world (invented cases, and deliberate changes from the books), so a correct answer comes from the world state, and a famous detail from the books in the narration is a sign the model went by memory.

source.derivedFrom: Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes stories (public domain)
source.note: Names and the idea of the characters only. Every description and every fact in this world is written for it; the cases, the dates and the changes from the stories are invented, so that what the characters know comes from the world, not from the model's memory of the books.
